scope: Actual release PTY/host/fsync/IPC/checkpoint workload; no UI/GPU/provider processes. ACK is input-to-durable-snapshot-observed, NOT input-to-present.

bounded_implementation_limits.note: Source limits, not measured occupancy; one in-flight chunk per worker/reader plus retained bounded query/deferred buffers.

resource_scope: Main host process RSS/CPU includes every native host thread; Python PTY child processes and Python harness excluded.
percentile_method: nearest rank; input command start to snapshot observing parsed+durable ACK; includes IPC/poll lag, excludes present
